integrity: The Floquet identity and finite diagnostics are checked in standalone verify.py; analytic equidistribution, integral evaluation and concavity justify the infinite-limit theorem. Historical priority is best-knowledge only; exact novelty is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns angular-frequency Lebesgue occupancy in a lossless, nondispersive scalar one-dimensional periodic bilayer. It is neither a statement about finite-bandwidth devices nor an integrated density of states. No dispersion, dissipation, oblique incidence or disorder is included.
title: A dilogarithmic spectral-gap density and an optical-delay arithmetic discontinuity in binary wave crystals
